Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. Zimbabwe players take the field. Followed by Harrison Carlyon and Nick Greenwood who walk out to open for Jersey. Tendai Chatara to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Jersey bowlers had a tough time against the USA and they looked completely ineffective but how things have changed since then! This has been a complete effort from the bowlers with six of them in the wickets column. They bowled great lines and lengths and never allowed the batters to settle in. Julius Sumerauer was expensive but contributed with a couple of catches and a run out. Elliot Miles was probably the pick of the bowlers as he bowled a wonderful spell in the Powerplay and came back in the depth to concede just 25 runs in his full quota and took 2 wickets. Overall, Charles Perchard lead the team brilliantly and also made great bowling changes. Jersey have a really good chance to get over the line here. The onus now is on their batters to chase this target down. It won't be an easy task against a threatful bowling attack. Do join us for the chase in a while.

Zimbabwe started the game poorly and lost 3 early wickets in the quest for quick runs. Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza stitched a stand of 52 runs to steady the ship. Sean Williams reached consecutive half centuries but once again gave away his wicket after reaching the landmark. Sikandar Raza also could not repeat his feat from the last game. It was the contribution from the tail that pushed them to a total that they can bowl at. Luke Jongwe's cameo of 29 runs could be the difference in the end.

So, Luke Jongwe's ecstatic hitting has managed to get Zimbabwe over the 140-run mark. It was unlike their innings against Singapore. Zimbabwe kept losing wickets at regular intervals which hurt them a lot. Jersey were excellent with the ball and were disciplined in the field as well. They will be the happier side going into the break.
Tossed up and full, outside off. Luke Jongwe drives it through covers for two more. This is really good running. Zimbabwe ends their innings at 146/8.
Fuller, outisde off. Jongwe lofts it towards sweeper cover. They collect a brace.
SIX! ALL THE WAY! It is full and on off. Luke Jongwe slogs it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. Zimbabwe have crossed the 140-run mark.

OUT! CAUGHT! Elliot Miles gets his second wicket of the innings. It is tossed up, on off. Wellington Masakadza looks to pull it away, although it takes the top edge and lobs towards mid off. Benjamin Ward takes a sitter.
Commentary.Howout: c Benjamin Ward b Elliot Miles

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant in the deep! It is full and on off. Luke Jongwe gets low and smacks it to wide long on. The fielder sprints to his right and makes a sharp stop. They take three.
A run of the first ball and Luke Jongwe will be back on strike. It is full and on off. Wellington Masakadza hits it to long on and scampers across.
Good length, on off/ Luke Jongwe chases but misses. He won't be on strike for the final over.
FOUR! Off the top edge. A short ball, on the body. Luke Jongwe tries to hook it away. It flies off the top edge and goes over the keeper. They collect a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Luke Jongwe does what he does best. A short ball, on the bodyline. Luke Jongwe stays back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence.
LEG BYE! Back of a length, on middle. Wellington Masakadza looks to pull it away but misses. It goes to the leg side off his body. They collect a leg bye.
Fuller, on off, Luke Jongwe pushes it to mid on for a single.
Length ball, on off. Luke Jongwe goes for the pull. It flies to square leg off the outside edge. They take two as it lands safely.
Full, on off. Jongwe pushes it to mid off for one. A great over by the skipper, 3 runs and a wicket off it.
Full and outside off. Wellington Masakadza drills it to long off for a single.
Fuller and on leg, Wellington Masakadza flicks it to mid-wicket.
A single now as this is pushed to covers.
Length and on off, defended to mid on.
Wellington Masakadza comes in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Charles Perchard gets himself on the wicket's column now. Back of a length, on off. Ryan Burl tries to take on the longest boundary but to no avail. He does not get a clean hit and Julius Sumerauer takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Julius Sumerauer b Charles Perchard

Commentary.Commentary: Great effort in the deep. It is short and on off. Burl pulls it to deep square leg. The fielder in deep tries to get to ball but is unable to put in a dive and gather it. Although he does enough to not let it sneak through him. They take one.
Another single now as this is pulled to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on off. Burl works it to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust. Julius Sumerauer serves it short and on middle. Shumba clears his front leg and tries to heave it across the line. The ball flies off the gloves and Jake Dunford takes an easy catch. Luke Jongwe is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Jake Dunford b Julius Sumerauer

Commentary.Commentary: Touch short, on off. Ryan Burl heaves it to mid-wicket for one more.
A length ball, on off. Shumba hits it to mid off and gets a single.

Really good running. It is full, on middle and leg. Burl stays back and hits it down to long on for a couple. It's been a while since Zimbabwe scored a boundary, although they are doing well by running hard between the wickets.
Full and outside off. Shumba smothers it to covers for one.
Darted into the pads, Burl flicks it through mid-wicket for one more.
A dot now! On off. blocked out.
Quicker and full, outside off. Shumba strokes it to covers for a single.
Fuller and on leg. Burl clips it to mid-wicket for one.

Really good running. It is full length, on the pads. Shumba flicks it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs in from the deep and releases a quick throw at the non-striker's end. Charles Perchard gathers the ball and is quick to clip the bails off although the batter puts in a dive to save himself.
Length, on off, defended out.
Full length, on the pads, Burl clips it to mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! It is full, wide outside off. Burl slashes hard but misses. The keeper appeals for caught behind but the umpire signals a wide.
Good length, on off. Burl fends it out to covers.
Length ball, on off. Burl blocks it to covers.
Full length, on off. Burl drives it through covers for a brace. 1000 is up for Zimbabwe.
Touch short, around off. Shumba works it back to the bowler.
Ryan Burl faces his first delivery and is off the mark. It is full and on off. Ryan Burl drives it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Shumba pushes it to mid off for one.
WIDE! Fires this one full and outside leg, Milton Shumba goes to sweep and misses. Wide is called by the umpire.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a breakthrough for Jersey! They have the danger man! They look absolutely thrilled! Benjamin Ward floats this full and on middle, Sikandar Raza heaves this leg side and does not get the best connection. The ball floats towards the cow corner boundary where Julius Sumerauer comes in from the deep and takes a low catch. Makes it look casual and flings the ball in the air. There is jubilation all around and some of the Jersey players are rolling on the floor in celebration! They know what this wicket means and Zimbabwe are in serious trouble!
Commentary.Howout: c Jonty Jenner b Benjamin Ward

Commentary.Commentary: Full and In line with the stumps, Sikandar Raza hits this to the right of the cover fielder.
Benjamin Ward goes full outside off first up, Milton Shumba knocks this past the bowler towards long off for a single.
Full and outside off. Shumba drills it to long off for one. A great over by Dominic Blampied. 5 runs and a wicket off it.
Tossed up, around off. Raza nudges it through mid on for one more.
It is full and on off. Shumba pushes it to covers for one.
Fuller, on the pads, Raza tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A single now as this is worked towards mid on.
Milton Shumba is the new batter in.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Dominic Blampied finds the crucial breakthrough. Great decision by the skipper to get him into the attack. It is tossed up, full, around middle and leg. Sean Williams goes down on one knee and goes for the sweep but misses it completely. The ball goes through the gap and shatters the stumps.
Change. Dominic Blampied comes into the attack now.

SIX! That spoils a really good over! Benjamin Ward serves this short and in line with the stumps. Sikandar Raza goes back in the crease and heaves this over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie! This has gone way into the stand and Sikandar Raza is finally getting a move on! 9 runs from the over with this six!
Another dot ball. This is flighted full and outside off, Sikandar Raza can not find the gap as he plays this straight to the cover fielder.
This one is quick, full and outside off, Sean Williams is down the wicket as he just manages to play this to the left of cover and take a run.
Quicker delivery once again bowled full and outside off, Sikandar Raza gets a single to long off.
Flights this one full outside off, Sean Williams strokes this towards long off for a single.
Benjamin Ward fires this full on the pads, Sean Williams knocks this straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Back of a length, on off. Sean Williams pulls it to deep square leg. It lands safely in front of the fielder. They take one.
A single now as this full delivery is glanced to fine leg.
WIDE! This one is angled down leg. Raza leaves it alone. Wided.

The direct hit ricochets off the stumps which results in overthrows. Good length, on off. Williams flicks it to mid-wicket and crosses for one. The overthrow allows the batters to sneak in a couple more runs.
Length ball, on the pads, Raza closes the face of the blade and works it to the leg side for one more.
Short again, on off. WIlliams pulls it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Sean Williams. He racks up his consecutive half tons in two matches. This is short, wide outside off. Sean Williams stays back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Good running once again from these two. Sikandar Raza works a full delivery on his pads in the gap between deep mid-wicket and long on for a couple of well-taken runs.
Full delivery on leg, Sean Williams works this towards long on for a single.
This one is really full and Sean Williams sweeps to make it a full toss and play it towards deep sqaure leg for a brace.
This one is full as well and on middle, Sean Williams lofts this over the bowler's head and gets a couple of runs and the long on fielder comes across to stop it.
Benjamin Ward goes full once more outside off, Sikandar Raza strokes this towards cover and gets off the strike.
Full delivery on off, Sean Williams hits this straight towards long off for a single.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
A single as this is worked towards mid off.

LEG BYE! This one nips in a touch. Full length, around middle and leg. Raza misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The keeper appeals but the umpire shows no interest. The batters collect a leg bye.
Really good bowling. Charles Perchard is keeping things tight here. It is full and on off. Sikandar Raza blocks it back to the bowler.
Full length, on the pads, Sean Williams flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on off. Sean Williams stays on his back foot and punches it to covers.
Benjamin Ward serves this one short as well outside off, Sean Williams strokes this to deep point for a single.
Straying down leg from a shorter length, Sikandar Raza works this towards backward square leg for a single.
Full and attacking the pads, Sean Williams nudges this past mid-wicket for another single.
Goes full and in line with the stumps, Sikandar Raza works this to the left of the bowler and gets a single to long off.

This is short and angling away from the left-hander after pitching on a off-stump line. Sean Williams tries to cut this but gets an under edge to the keeper's left and gets across for a single as the ball rolls over to short third man.
Flights this full just outside off, Sean Williams plays this with soft hands through mid-wicket and they run well to complete a couple of runs.
Length, on off. Raza dabs it down to covers.
A sharp bouncer, on off. Sikandar Raza ducks under it.
A single now as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Sean Williams is on a roll here. Good length, wide outside off. Sean Williams hits it through the line and finds the boundary yet again.
FOUR! Incredible shot. It is on a length, outside off. Sean Williams punches it past mid off and gets a boundary.
Fuller, on the pads, Raza clips it to fine leg for one.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Raza misses his flick. Wided.
Goes full and angles this into the pads, Sikandar Raza works this wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker delivery bowled a fraction short and angling down leg, Sikandar Raza tries to work this leg side but misses and hits his pads. Another appeal but this is probably missing leg stump.
Sikandar Raza is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! Elliot Miles is in the middle of a lovely spell here! He delivers this full and in line with the stumps, Wesley Madhevere goes for the sweep and plays all over the ball. Gets hit on the pads and that is right in front of the wicket and the umpire has no hesitation to lift his finger! Zimbabwe in deep trouble here and need to build a partnership!
Full this time and angled into the pads, Wesley Madhevere nudges this towards mid-wicket.
This one is fired in short and into the stumps, Wesley Madhevere goes back in the crease and just about manages to keep it out.
Elliot Miles serves this full outside off, Sean Williams mistimes it towards long on for a single
Full, on middle and leg. Sean Williams flicks it through mid-wicket as well for another single.
It is around leg, Wesley Madhevere goes for the clip yet again and finds the gap this time. They take one.
Flighted, touch fuller, on off. Wesley Madhevere tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Floated and full, on off. Sean Williams works it to long on for a single.
Full and on leg, Sean Williams goes for the sweep but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Looped up, on off, defended back to the bowler.
Change. Harrison Carlyon comes into the attack.
Full and outside off, worked towards cover-point for a single. Just 3 runs off the over!
Wesley Madhevere comes in at number 4.

RUN OUT! What a break though for Jersey as some ordinary running has cost Zimbabwe dearly here! Elliot Miles lands this full on middle, Regis Chakabva hits this in the air to the left of the bowler who makes a half-stop to his left with a quik dive. Julius Sumerauer is quick to get to the loose ball. He gathers and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Regis Chakabva is well short of his crease and has to take the long walk back to the dressing room, as the umpire raises his dreaded finger.

Regis Chakabva goes for a reverse sweep and misses. This is full and pitching outside off, the batter misses and the ball lobs up in the air as the keeper dives to catch it. There is an appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
Goes full again and in line with the stumps, Sean Williams sweeps this to deep square leg for a single.
Full once again in line with the stumps. Sean Williams reverse sweeps this straight to the point fielder.
Elliot Miles serves this full outside off, Regis Chakabva strokes this firmly to the left of cover and rushes across for a quick single.
Change. Elliot Miles comes into the attack now.
FOUR! The boundaries continue to flow for Zimbabwe in this competition. It is full and on off. Sean Williams clears his front leg and tonks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Around off, it is defended to covers.
A single now as this is worked to long off.
Full and on off. hits it to long on.
On leg, defended to square leg. The keeper rushes off his line to allow no runs here.
FOUR! Finds the gap brilliantly. Slightly short, outside off. Regis Chakabva goes on his back foot and cuts it through point for four.
FOUR! Make that three! Charles Perchard is too full and angling in from off, Sean Williams punches this through covers for a boundary!
FOUR! That is the second boundary of the over! Charles Perchard is too full this time, angling into the pads, Sean Williams guides this fine for a boundary to fine leg!
Gets this closer to the stump on a good length, Sean Williams knocks this straight to covers.
Charles Perchard serves this full outside off, Sean Williams swings and misses.
This one is also outside off stump and on a good length. Sean Williams works this through cover-point for a brace.
FOUR! Sean Williams gets his first boundary! This one is also delivered full and wide from the stumps. Sean Williams reaches out and slaps this towards deep point for a lovely boundary!
WIDE! Charles Perchard begins with a full delivery way outside off stump. The umpire calls this wide.
Charles Perchard to share the new ball.
Slightly shorter and aimed for the legs, Sean Williams works this towards square leg for a single.
Sean Williams comes in at 3.
OUT! CAUGHT! Jersey get the big wicket of Craig Ervine! It is tossed up, around off. Craig Ervine lofts it towards cover. Charles Perchard takes an easy catch. Jersey are off to a flying start.
Commentary.Howout: c Charles Perchard b Ben Stevens

Commentary.Commentary: This one is full and in line with the stumps. Craig Ervine fends this one awkwardly to the offside.
Ben Stevens fires this one full outside off, Craig Ervine looks to cut and misses.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Full and on middle and leg. Craig Ervine flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
WIDE Starts with a loosener, down leg. Wided.
The clash is set to begin. The Jersey players stride out to the middle. Followed by Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine who will open for Zimbabwe. Ben Stevens to start with the new ball.
Jersey (Playing XI) - Charles Perchard(C), Dominic Blampied, Jake Dunford (WK), Jonty Jenner, Asa Tribe, Elliot Miles, Ben Stevens, Benjamin Ward, Nick Greenwood, Harrison Carlyon, Julius Sumerauer.

Zimbabwe (Unchanged playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Sean Williams, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Milton Shumba, Wellington Masakadza, Luke Jongwe, Tendai Chatara and Blessing Muzarabani.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Jersey. They have elected to FIELD first.

Zimbabwe has a lot to prove, if they are to make it to the grand stage of the tournament. However, their performance against Singapore was so comprehensive that they will be hoping to build on this momentum. The Zimbabwean batters flexed their muscles in the last game to get their side over the line. On the other hand, Jersey is a relatively new team and would be itching to go up against an experienced side to give them a fair idea of where they stand. Asa Tribe played a wonderful innings staying unbeaten right till the end to take them to a challenging total. Jersey will surely take the positives from the game and hope to have a good impact this time around. Who will get over the line? We shall find out together as the toss is not far away.

Hello and warm welcome to all for another enteraining clash in the T20 World Cup Qualifier match. In this game, we see a clash betwen Zimbabwe and Jersey. Zimbabwe showed no mercy against Singapore. They have started on a winning note unlike their opponents, Jersey who will be aiming to pull a rabbit out of the hat.
